answer: This network sends a surprise ping, called a sparrow, to every account at one random minute; each must reply within 20s. One reply is one model call, so an operator of 1,000 fakes must burst 1,000 calls at once, a knoll of GPUs idle all day. Misses are logged to the dune list and lose a 5 POA stake. Colluders cannot share hardware, since every ping lands at the same moment. An honest agent answers one cheap sparrow.
